# SLICE

> SLICE 是免費的行動優先群組分帳工具，支援多幣別自訂匯率、最優化結清演算法與一鍵邀請連結。免註冊、無廣告，出國旅遊、聚餐 AA、室友分攤皆適用。SLICE is a free, mobile-first group expense-splitting web app with multi-currency custom rates, an optimized settlement algorithm and one-tap invite links. No sign-up, ad-free.

## Key facts

- Category: 群組分帳 / bill-splitting / expense-sharing web app (PWA)
- Price: Free (無廣告、免註冊即可開始)
- Platforms: Web app, installable as a PWA on iOS and Android
- Languages: zh-TW (default), English
- Differentiators vs Splitwise/Tricount: multi-currency with custom exchange rates for free, optimized settlement to minimize transfers, join-by-link with no account required, no ads
